decision: Keep the V1 server export and add a V2 setup on the same default export
why: Published installs still load server(). OpenCode 2 only calls setup(). The migration guide shows this dual export, and dropping V1 would break current users.

decision: Do not depend on @opencode/plugin at runtime
why: The loader only needs id and setup. The package pulls effect 4.0.1, which can clash with the V1 plugin SDK effect beta.

decision: Normalize V2 events into the existing tab-title event shape
why: Tab title already understands session status, questions, and permissions. V2 moved those fields under data and replaced question events with form events.

decision: Normalize V2 events with zod and feed the existing tab-title model
why: Question events are gone in V2. Forms replaced them. Status and permission fields moved under data.

decision: Register V2 tools by converting the existing zod args to JSON schema
why: The tool execute functions already exist. V2 only needs a name, a JSON schema, and a content wrapper.

decision: Wake a finished pane with ctx.session.prompt instead of promptAsync
why: V2 has no promptAsync. session.prompt admits a user prompt and returns the inbox item, which is the wake.

decision: OpenCode 2.0.29 marked the built plugin active
why: A temp project discovered the package through index.ts, which re-exported dist/index.mjs. The plugin list showed id opencode-zellij and status active.

decision: A form reply leaves the session running until idle
why: The existing tab-title model marks a question as running as well as needs-input. Clearing the question does not clear running.

decision: Do not add a root index.ts for the published package
why: OpenCode 2.0.29 skips a local checkout that has no root index file, but npm and git installs resolve package.json exports. The README install path is the package name.

decision: OpenCode 2.0.29 marked the packaged code active
why: The duplicate-ID error proves both local shims loaded the same default export. The active one used index.ts re-exporting dist/index.mjs.

decision: V2 events carry type, data, and location; subscriptions ignore the rest
why: The server log lines print event.type, event.location.directory, and event.data for session events. The schema files name session.created, session.status, permission, form, and session.execution events.

decision: ctx.session.prompt admits the wake message for a finished pane
why: Commands run through session.prompt. Prompt admission is the path that wakes a session. Synthetic messages do not.

decision: Answer the comment audit: named form alias and parsed tool inputs
why: Comment-sicko accepted the excess server property with a live loader proof and required a named form alias plus parsing host input before V1 execute.
